description: Some subset of \( (\mathbb N,0,S)\) is invariant under every automorphism but is not definable even with finite parameters.
signature:

  ∃ s,
    ¬Set.univ.Definable₁ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BasicStructures.naturalSuccessorLanguage s ∧
      ∀ (g : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BasicStructures.naturalSuccessorLanguage.Equiv ℕ ℕ),
        Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Definability.Invariant ⇑g {x | x 0 ∈ s}
